items.quote: Keith and team deliver exceptional results, they do it all. From wonderful design and install to bringing elevated ideas, they are the design professionals who are true craftsmen. We are in love with our speakeasy space.

Keith is a master at quality cabinetry and built ins. Our full kitchen remodel came to a screeching halt due to a bait and switch by our contractor, when they put in awful, poor quality, mismatched cardboard cabinets. Keith fixed it.

We very highly recommend Keith for all your cabinet or woodworking needs. He has replaced cabinets and mirrors in three bathrooms and our kitchen. He also built a coffee station for us. Keith is a perfectionist with his work.
